[SWS_Rte_91194] Definition of callback function Rte_[<Partition>_]COMCbkTp
RxIndication
Status:
DRAFT
Previous identifiers: SWS_Rte_91132
⌈
Service Name
Rte_[<Partition>_]COMCbkTpRxIndication (draft)
Syntax
void Rte_[<Partition>_]COMCbkTpRxIndication (
CbkHandleIdType ComUserCbkHandleId,
Std_ReturnType result
)
Service ID [hex]
0x0103
Sync/Async
Synchronous
▽
△
Reentrancy
Non Reentrant for same sn, otherwise Reentrant
ComUserCbkHandleId
Com user callback handle Id corresponding to the received I-PDU
Parameters (in)
result
E_OK: The I-PDU was received successfully.
E_NOT_OK: Reception of the I-PDU failed.
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
None
Description
This callback is generated when there is a read access configured for the data item associated
to the large data path (TP) PDU to be received. It is called after an I-PDU has been received via
the TP API, the result indicates whether the transmission was successful or not.
In the prototype, <Partition> is the shortName of the EcucPartition referenced from the
RteComUserEcucPartitionRef parameter (see [ECUC_Rte_09212]) of the RteComUser
for which the Callback is being generated.
Tags: atp.Status=draft
Available via
Rte_Com.h
⌋
It is configured in ComUserModuleCnf :
via
the
ComUserCallbackName
(See
[ECUC_Com_10036])
parameter
where
the
ComUserCallbackType
(See
[ECUC_Com_10034])
is
set
to
COM_TP_RX_INDICATION
